name.en-US: An Explanation of the Baltimore Catechism

description.en-US: Baltimore Catechism No. 4: Fr Thomas L. Kinkead's An Explanation of the Baltimore Catechism of Christian Doctrine (1891). The 37 lessons of the Baltimore Catechism with every question and answer in place (numbered to agree with No. 2) and a full explanation after each, drawn from Scripture, parables and daily life, followed by the list of numbered questions on the explanations.
description.pt-BR: Catecismo de Baltimore nº 4: Explicação do Catecismo de Baltimore da Doutrina Cristã (1891), do Pe. Thomas L. Kinkead. As 37 lições do Catecismo de Baltimore com cada pergunta e resposta no lugar (numeradas como no nº 2) e uma explicação completa após cada uma, tirada da Escritura, das parábolas e da vida diária, seguidas da lista de perguntas numeradas sobre as explicações.

sources.description: Project Gutenberg #14554, 'An Explanation of the Baltimore Catechism of Christian Doctrine' (Kinkead; Benziger reprint, imprimatur New York 5 Sept 1891, re-approved 29 June 1921; transcription by Dennis McCarthy from catholic.net files). Tier A: public domain in the United States (1891 text; printing of 1921). The general index (page-style list of question numbers) and the Gutenberg licence were left out; transcriber's notes removed.
